company_description:
Corvale Mobility is a privately held transportation and software company headquartered in Kraków, Poland. It operates long-distance bus services and a growing passenger-rail network across Central Europe, supported by an online booking and trip-tracking platform. Its asset-light model combines Corvale’s technology, network planning and brand with regional operating partners. The company is preparing to introduce a new train fleet later this decade and sees data and machine learning as priorities for improving its platform.

Founded by transport and software professionals, Corvale remains founder-led and describes itself as engineering-led. Teams take end-to-end ownership of their systems, while collaboration and problem-solving across international teams are central to its approach. Its stated values are **Lead, Shape, Own, and Enjoy the journey**—reflecting initiative, career ownership and shared purpose. Corvale also emphasizes technology-led travel, sustainability and openness to new ideas. Employee feedback points to a collaborative, fast-moving culture that values innovation, flexibility, development and appreciation. Technology roles may be available to employees or independent contractors; employees can work hybrid and receive travel benefits.

results.title: Corvale Mobility wins regional workplace culture awards | Corvale
